netfilter_hooks.reason: Registered in struct nf_hook_ops; called by nf_hook_slow for every packet that passes the hook point (conntrack, IPVS, synproxy, ...).

nft_chain_hooks.reason: nf_tables chain types' per-family packet entry points (nft_do_chain_ipv4, nft_do_chain_ipv6, ...).

xtables_match_target.reason: iptables/ip6tables/arptables/ebtables matches and targets; called for each packet by the table walker in net/ipv4|ipv6/netfilter, which is outside the analysed code.

netfilter_core.reason: Called by the IP stack (NF_HOOK) for every hooked packet - where packets enter netfilter.

nfnetlink_handlers.reason: struct nfnl_callback message handlers: one per netlink message type for nf_tables, ipset, conntrack, queue, log, ... Their input is the message sent by a userspace program.

nfnetlink_input.reason: Where every netfilter netlink message arrives (.input of the nfnetlink socket).

xtables_checkentry.reason: Validates a new iptables rule's match/target options; runs when a program installs rules via setsockopt.

nft_expr_eval.reason: nf_tables expression evaluators. Already one step below nft_do_chain, so seeding them mainly over-weights nf_tables code.

ipset_uadt.reason: ipset userspace add/del/test handlers. CIRCULAR for CVE-2024-53141: its vulnerable function bitmap_ip_uadt is itself a uadt function.
